Maya (new-hire): Hi all — quick onboarding Q. Where's the canonical Notion spot for onboarding templates (RFC, runbook) and who can grant edit/duplicate? Some pages I found are view-only.

rachel_peopleops: Welcome Maya! The canonical location is Notion > Company Home > Templates > Team Templates and Eng space > Onboarding. For edit access we add people to role groups (Engineering Editors). DM me your work email and I'll add you.

oliver_docs: If you hit view-only use the "Request access" button. That creates a docs ticket. If you add a short reason like "ramp + need RFC copy" and tag @oliver_docs I can approve quickly. Note: some templates are locked to prevent accidental edits.

kevin_eng: Also: Team Restricted pages (Infra/SRE) require team membership. If you need temporary access tag me and rachel with why and for how long.

Maya (new-hire): Thanks — maya@redwood.com. I just need to duplicate the RFC template and add a link to my ramp doc.

docs-bot: docs-requests  ticket DR-8034 created for maya@redwood.com (requested by rachel_peopleops). Link: https://notion.company/requests/DR-8034

oliver_docs: Approved DR-8034, adding Maya to Engineering Editors. You should see the Notion invite soon.

Maya (new-hire): Invite arrived — can duplicate RFC now. One tiny Q: preferred filename for shared ramp notes?

kevin_eng: Use "first-last (team) - ramp" for shared, "first-last - ramp" for private. Put shared ramps under Eng > Ramps and add a one-line summary at top.

Maya (new-hire): Great, thanks everyone!
